newsitem.title: CHINA: Liu Chong Hing Bnk in cash injection talks.
newsitem.headline: Liu Chong Hing Bnk in cash injection talks.

text.p: Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd is in talks with COSCO group and other parties on possible capital injection into the bank, and an announcement is expected later on Friday, said Nam Lee Yick, a director of the bank.
"We are now in a meeting and no decision has been made yet," Lam told Reuters in an interview. "We will evaluate all proposals and we announce our decision later today."
"We hope the announcement could be made as soon as possible, maybe at lunch time," he added.
Brokers said there were rumours that COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd planned to lift its stake in Liu Chong Hing Bank, which is controlled by Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd.
COSCO (Hong Kong) was expected to inject its interest in the bank into its listed arm COSCO Pacific Ltd after the completion of the deal, one broker said.
But Lam declined to specify whether COSCO group members COSCO (Hong Kong) or COSCO Pacific were involved in the talks.

Trading of shares of COSCO Pacific and Liu Chong Hing Investment was suspended on Friday morning, pending announcements, following the suspension of trade in Liu Chong Hing Bank shares on Thursday afternoon.
The bank's shares last traded Thursday morning at HK$24.30, up HK$4.85, or 24.94 percent.
